Paper: Patterns of genomic loss of heterozygosity predict homologous recombination repair defects in epithelial ovarian cancer.

N: 640 ovarian tumors; 57 cell lines; assay denominators differ
Ground_truth_HRD_definition: BRCA1/2 defects with LOH; RAD51C methylation explored
HRD_calculation_method: LOH segments >15 Mb but less than whole chromosome
Validation_strategy: Two independent ovarian cohorts and cell lines
documented_fact: The original HRD score counts LOH regions; it is not the later three-component sum. Scars can persist after reversion.
inference: HRD score is an ambiguous historical name.

Paper: Telomeric allelic imbalance indicates defective DNA repair and sensitivity to DNA-damaging agents.
review_status: Newly available author manuscript; consequential methods reviewed
Cancer_cohort: Breast cell lines; Cisplatin-1/2 TNBC; TCGA ovarian and triple-negative breast
N: Cisplatin-1 27 profiled; Cisplatin-2 26 after ASCAT/purity; TCGA OV 218; TCGA breast 78; cell-line assay Ns vary
Input_datatype: Allele-specific copy number and allelic imbalance
Ground_truth_HRD_definition: Platinum response and BRCA1/2 status; NtAI is evaluated as a scar biomarker
LOH_definition: Not a standalone LOH endpoint; copy-neutral LOH is explicitly recognized as a possible source of telomeric AI
TAI_definition: Unequal allele copy number with at least one allele present, extending to the subtelomere without crossing the centromere
Upstream_allele_specific_CN_method: AROMAv2/CalMaTe; TumorBoost with paired normal; ASCAT
Purity_ploidy_correction: ASCAT correction; samples below 36% purity and failed profiles excluded in the reported cohorts
CNV_method: AROMAv2/CalMaTe; TumorBoost when paired normal available; ASCAT corrects purity/ploidy
Raw_IDAT_MU_requirement: Methylation IDAT/M/U absent; SNP-array allele-intensity/genotype input required
Validation_strategy: Multiple trials, cell-line datasets, and TCGA cohorts; no predictive-model CV
Performance_metrics: ROC AUC/rank tests and platinum-response associations; exact values by cohort
Calibration_uncertainty: No formal probability calibration or individual uncertainty interval
Single_sample_compatible: Yes after validated allele-specific profiling and QC
Major_strengths: Exact TAI definition and purity/ploidy-aware allele inference across platforms
Major_limitations: Platform-dependent probe thresholds; low-purity failures; historical scar can persist after repair restoration
Implementation_ideas: Use as truth fixture: AI means unequal allele copy with at least one allele present; telomeric region reaches subtelomere without crossing centromere
documented_fact: TAI was derived from SNP-array allele signals with ASCAT, not total CN. Copy-neutral LOH is explicitly a possible source of telomeric AI.
inference: Neither ordinary beta values nor methylation-derived total CN contains the demonstrated input needed for canonical TAI.
recommendation: Retain canonical TAI only for allele-aware reference data; call total-CN telomeric features telomeric CN alteration burden.

Paper: Homologous Recombination Deficiency (HRD) Score Predicts Response to Platinum-Containing Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy in Patients with Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
review_status: Newly available author manuscript; main methods reviewed, component supplement unavailable
Cancer_cohort: Three neoadjuvant TNBC platinum trials; independent breast/ovarian threshold cohort
N: Threshold cohort 497 breast + 561 ovarian (268 BRCA1/2-deficient); PrECOG evaluable 70; pooled cisplatin evaluable 50
Assay: 54,091-SNP custom NGS panel; MIP SNP array for 10 PrECOG cases
Ground_truth_HRD_definition: HRD-high if score >42 and/or deleterious BRCA1/2 mutation
HRD_calculation_method: Unweighted HRD-LOH + TAI + LST; individual algorithm details deferred to supplement/prior papers
LOH_definition: Component algorithm deferred to supplement/prior paper in the local manuscript
LST_definition: Component algorithm deferred to supplement/prior paper in the local manuscript
TAI_definition: Component algorithm deferred to supplement/prior paper in the local manuscript
Upstream_allele_specific_CN_method: Allelic-imbalance profiles from a 54,091-SNP targeted sequencing panel; MIP array for 10 cases
Purity_ploidy_correction: Not reported in sufficient detail in the reviewed local main text
CNV_method: Allelic-imbalance profiles from targeted SNP reads; platform correlation 0.94 in 31 paired samples
Raw_IDAT_MU_requirement: No methylation-array input; targeted SNP read counts/allelic profiles required
Model_class: Prespecified additive scar score; logistic association analyses
Training_strategy: Threshold set independent of therapy cohorts; cutoff chosen at fifth percentile of BRCA-deficient scores
Validation_strategy: Three clinical trial cohorts with prespecified cisplatin analysis
External_validation: Two pooled cisplatin trials separate from threshold cohort
Performance_metrics: AUC 0.761 for RCB0/I and 0.747 for pCR; sensitivity at 42 was 85% and 93%
Calibration_uncertainty: Cutoff selected independently; no individual prediction interval or cross-cancer calibration
Cross_cancer_compatible: Threshold derived in breast/ovarian; no pan-cancer validation
Code_software: Commercial assay details partly in supplement/prior paper
Major_strengths: Independent threshold cohort and explicit component sum
Major_limitations: Commercial pipeline details incomplete locally; treatment prediction and current HR function are distinct
Direct_relevance_KIDS26: Defines the reference endpoint and demonstrates independent thresholding
Implementation_ideas: Keep continuous sum primary; store cutoff provenance separately
documented_fact: The canonical combined score is an unweighted allele-aware LOH+TAI+LST sum. The clinical cutoff was trained in breast/ovarian BRCA-deficient tumors, not pediatric CNS tumors.
inference: A value of 42 is not automatically portable across cancers or assays.
recommendation: Predict continuous reference HRDsum and do not emit an HRD-high probability without tumor-specific calibration.

Paper: Intratumor Heterogeneity of Homologous Recombination Deficiency in Primary Breast Cancer.
review_status: Newly available full article; methods/results reviewed
Cancer_cohort: Prospective primary stage I-III breast cancer multi-region sampling
N: 99 biopsies from 33 tumors; 81 biopsies/32 cancers analyzed; 70 HRD scores from 31 patients
Assay: 54,091-SNP NGS capture plus BRCA1/2 and BRCA1 promoter methylation
Ground_truth_HRD_definition: HRD score >=42 or tumor BRCA mutation
HRD_calculation_method: LOH (>15 Mb subchromosomal) + TAI (to subtelomere, not centromere crossing) + LST (breaks between >10 Mb regions after removing <3 Mb regions)
LST_definition: Breaks between adjacent regions greater than 10 Mb after removing regions smaller than 3 Mb
TAI_definition: Allelic imbalance extending to a subtelomere without crossing the centromere
Upstream_allele_specific_CN_method: Hidden Markov segmentation of a 54,091-SNP targeted panel; algorithm similar to Popova
Purity_ploidy_correction: Not reported in sufficient detail in the reviewed article
CNV_method: Hidden Markov segmentation; allele-specific CN algorithm similar to Popova
Methylation_preprocessing: BRCA1 promoter: quantitative NGS at 10 CpGs; array methylation not used
Raw_IDAT_MU_requirement: No methylation-array input; SNP allelic read profiles required
Validation_strategy: Three spatial biopsies per tumor where material passed
Performance_metrics: Patient-level HRD score intraclass correlation 0.977; category/BRCA status perfect concordance in available biopsies
Calibration_uncertainty: Intraclass correlation reported; no model probability calibration or individual intervals
Major_limitations: Small single-center cohort and commercial assay
Direct_relevance_KIDS26: Supports patient grouping and distinguishes within-tumor from between-tumor variation
Implementation_ideas: Group all patient/model-lineage specimens; never split related biopsies across folds
documented_fact: Allele-aware HRDsum was spatially reproducible in this small breast cohort, but only 31 patients had scores.
inference: Lineage grouping remains mandatory even when scar scores appear stable within one adult tumor type.
recommendation: Keep patient/lineage grouped validation; do not treat related PBTP models as independent.

Paper: Copy number signatures and mutational processes in cancer.
review_status: Newly available author manuscript; main methods/results reviewed
Cancer_cohort: High-grade serous ovarian cancer: BriTROC-1, PCAWG-OV, TCGA-OV
N: BriTROC 142 patients/300 samples; 91 high-quality discovery profiles; PCAWG 112; TCGA 415
Assay: Shallow WGS, deep WGS, and SNP array
Input_datatype: Absolute total-CN segments and breakpoint-derived distributions
Ground_truth_HRD_definition: Signatures associated with mutational processes including HRD; not canonical HRDsum
LOH_definition: Absent; total/absolute CN signatures are the target representation
LST_definition: Absent; breakpoint distributions are not named canonical LST
Upstream_allele_specific_CN_method: Battenberg used as a paired WGS check; external TCGA/PCAWG absolute CN includes ABSOLUTE/Battenberg sources
Purity_ploidy_correction: QDNAseq plus TP53-VAF probabilistic purity/ploidy/absolute-CN fit; matched WGS checks
CNV_method: QDNAseq plus TP53-VAF probabilistic absolute-CN fit for sWGS; Battenberg paired check; ABSOLUTE for external cohorts
Raw_IDAT_MU_requirement: No methylation arrays; sequencing read-depth inputs
Feature_selection: Six CN distributions: segment size, breaks/10 Mb, adjacent CN change, segment CN, breaks/arm, oscillating-CN run length
Training_strategy: 36 mixture components; seven signatures chosen using 1,000 NMF starts and 1,000 permuted nulls
Validation_strategy: Independent PCAWG-OV and TCGA-OV decompositions; matched sWGS/WGS purity/ploidy in 34 samples
Performance_metrics: Median signature-weight correlation 0.86 across external cohorts; survival test C-index 0.56
Calibration_uncertainty: NMF stability and null permutations reported; no individual predictive interval
Single_sample_compatible: Exposure assignment possible after signatures fixed
Cross_cancer_compatible: Not demonstrated; HGSOC signatures expected to expand in other cancers
Code_software: QDNAseq, Battenberg, ABSOLUTE, FlexMix, NMF, YAPSA
Major_strengths: Explicit resolution/purity/ploidy QC and independent CN-platform checks
Major_limitations: Total-CN process signatures are assay/pipeline/ploidy sensitive and not canonical allele-aware scars
Implementation_ideas: Borrow segment/breakpoint distributions only after conumee2 benchmark; record callable denominator and ploidy
documented_fact: The seven signatures were derived from total/absolute CN features with strong quality filtering; the paper explicitly warns that preprocessing and ploidy alter signatures.
inference: This supports a total-CN structural branch but cannot recover LOH or TAI without alleles.
recommendation: Keep total-CN features secondary and name them as structural/CN signatures, not HRDsum components.

Paper: Genomic Scar Score: A robust model predicting homologous recombination deficiency based on genomic instability.
local_file: ../papers/BJOG - 2022 - Yuan - Genomic Scar Score  A robust model predicting homologous recombination deficiency based on genomic.pdf
review_status: Newly available full article; methods/results reviewed
Cancer_cohort: Ovarian and breast development; ovarian PARPi cohort

LOH_definition: Not a canonical standalone component; LOH-related event categories enter the 28-feature SVM
LST_definition: Not a canonical standalone component; breakpoints enter the feature set
Upstream_allele_specific_CN_method: Sequenza v3 on hg19 using read depth and B-allele frequency
Purity_ploidy_correction: Sequenza estimates purity and ploidy; values are explicit inputs/context
CNV_method: Sequenza v3 hg19, default parameters, read depth plus BAF
Raw_IDAT_MU_requirement: No methylation arrays; 24K/72K SNP-capture reads required
Feature_selection: CN events by length/site/type plus breakpoints; features retained only if occurrence count exceeded training N
Training_strategy: Penalty C chosen by three-fold internal CV; extremes used for training
Validation_strategy: Independent BRCA-deficient/quiescent test; panel concordance; separate PARPi outcome cohort
Performance_metrics: 24K test AUC 0.996, accuracy 95.5%; 24K/72K r=0.89; PARPi PFS 9.4 vs 4.4 months
Calibration_uncertainty: SVM probability used; formal calibration and individual uncertainty not reported

Code_software: BWA, GATK, MuTect2, ANNOVAR, Sequenza, scikit-learn 0.22.1

Major_limitations: Extreme-group design inflates discrimination; no pediatric/cancer-held-out transfer; probability scale differs from HRDsum

Implementation_ideas: Do not port its features to methylation total CN; possible WGS-reference comparator after development

inference: Its high AUC does not show canonical scars can be obtained from methylation total CN.
recommendation: Do not replace elastic-net CpG regression; consider only as an allele-aware genomic comparator.

Input_datatype: Somatic mutations and allele-aware copy-number states
Ground_truth_HRD_definition: Mutational signature 3 plus genomic scars and clinical PARP-inhibitor response
HRD_calculation_method: LOH and LST-like measures; no methylation-derived canonical HRDsum
LOH_definition: Copy-neutral and non-copy-neutral LOH regions greater than 15 Mb; whole-chromosome handling follows the study implementation
LST_definition: Breaks between segments greater than 10 Mb after filtering small segments
Upstream_allele_specific_CN_method: Matched tumor-normal WES/WGS allele-specific copy-number analysis
Purity_ploidy_correction: Not reported in sufficient detail in the reviewed main article
CNV_method: Allele-aware sequencing CN with matched normal
Raw_IDAT_MU_requirement: No methylation-array input; matched sequencing required
Validation_strategy: Cohort survey plus olaparib response and acquired resistance
Performance_metrics: Descriptive genomic prevalence and clinical response
Calibration_uncertainty: No predictive calibration or individual interval; descriptive rare-cohort evidence
Single_sample_compatible: Sequencing is sample-level; no methylation predictor
Major_strengths: Matched-normal sequencing and clinically linked HRD evidence in a rare tumor
Major_limitations: Very small cohort and no methylation array
Direct_relevance_KIDS26: Rare-cancer motivation while reinforcing allele-aware reference labels
Implementation_ideas: Preserve component labels and do not infer allelic imbalance from total CN
documented_fact: Eleven advanced chordomas had matched tumor-normal sequencing; LOH regions exceeded 15 Mb and LST counted breaks between segments exceeding 10 Mb after small-segment filtering.
inference: Rare-tumor relevance does not validate methylation-derived canonical HRDsum.
recommendation: Use as biological motivation, not as evidence to change the primary model.
